props.description: Initial hour (1–12 in 12h mode, 0–23 in 24h).

props.name: defaultMinute
props.description: Initial minute (0–59).

props.name: defaultPeriod
props.description: Initial AM/PM (12h mode only). Default "AM".

props.name: label
props.description: Overline label. Default "Enter Time".

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Footer — Cancel.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Footer — OK. Receives the chosen time.

props.name: use24Hour
props.description: Use 24-hour clock (hides the AM/PM toggle). Default false.

props.name: children
props.description: Supporting message line.

props.name: icon
props.description: Show the leading circular badge icon. Pass a node to override the glyph. Default true.

props.name: onClose
props.description: When provided, renders a close (×) button wired to this handler.

props.name: title
props.description: Bold heading (e.g. "Info !").

props.name: variant
props.description: Status variant — defaults to `info`.

components.name: useToast
components.description:
useToast — access the imperative toast API from any descendant of
`<ToastProvider>`: `const { toast, dismiss } = useToast()`.

props.name: children
props.description: Application subtree that gains access to `useToast()`.

props.name: duration
props.description:
Default auto-dismiss timeout in ms (overridable per toast via
`toast({ duration })`; `0` persists). Default 6000.

props.name: max
props.description:
Maximum number of toasts visible at once; further toasts queue and
surface as earlier ones leave. Default 5.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled on/off state

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Uncontrolled initial state (default false)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled state — Figma "Disabled on" / "Disabled Off" variants

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next state when the user flips the switch

props.name: children
props.description:
A single focusable/hoverable trigger element. Tooltip clones it
(`cloneElement`) to attach hover/focus handlers and `aria-describedby`,
merging with any handlers, ref and describedby the child already has —
no wrapper element is added.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the bubble element.

props.name: content
props.description:
The tooltip text. Keep it short and **never interactive** — a tooltip
disappears on blur/leave, so links or buttons inside it are unreachable
by keyboard and screen readers. Plain text (or text-level markup) only.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay in ms before the bubble shows on hover/focus. Default 300.

props.name: id
props.description: id of the bubble (defaults to a generated id) — wired to `aria-describedby`.

props.name: offset
props.description: Gap in px between the trigger and the bubble. Default 4.

props.name: placement
props.description:
Preferred placement; flips to the opposite vertical side automatically
when there is not enough viewport space. Default `'bottom-start'`.
